title: Unscripted: Overengineering Isn't What You Think It Is
abstract:
Whatever you think overengineering is, the title of this one says you've got it wrong. What Barry O'Reilly actually means by that, he's saving for the stage.

Andrea Magnorsky is taking it up with him, and Barry wants the room in it too, so expect to be asked what you think.

This is our unscripted stage. No slides, no script, and no idea where it ends up.
